description: Search for real-world places by text. Use this when the user needs to find a hotel, restaurant, venue, airport, station, port, parking location, or other place before adding or editing a trip segment.

included_type.description: Optional place type bias, such as lodging, restaurant, airport, train_station, parking, tourist_attraction, or point_of_interest

language.description: Optional BCP 47 language code for place data

location_bias.description: Optional latitude/longitude used to bias search results

max_results.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

query.description: The place search text, such as a hotel name, restaurant, airport, venue, station, or full address

radius_meters.description: Optional radius in meters around location_bias

name: places_search
title: Search places
